response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have had enough of this drab, medieval aesthetic. It's time for a change.

ZORVATH
(nervously)
But, your majesty, the people love the traditional look. It's... it's... (he consults a parchment)...timeless.

KING
(dismissively)
Timeless? Ha! I want something new, something bold, something... (he searches for the right word)...vaporwave.

ZORVATH
(confused)
Vaporwave, your majesty? I'm not sure I understand.

KING
(excitedly)
It's a style, Zorvath! A fusion of ancient and modern, with a dash of futurism and a whole lot of nostalgia. Think neon-lit castles, pixelated knights, and a healthy dose of irony.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
I see. And how do you propose we achieve this... vaporwave aesthetic?

KING
(determined)
We'll start by replacing the traditional suits of armor with... (he snaps his fingers)...glow-in-the-dark, neon-colored exoskeletons. And the banners? Gone. Replaced with... (he consults a sketchbook)... pixelated, glitch-art emblems.

ZORVATH
(hesitantly)
I'm not sure, your majesty...

KING
(firmly)
Trust me, Zorvath. This is the future. And I will be the king of the future.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his advisors, who are all staring at him in confusion.

KING
(to the advisors)
Now, let's talk about the color palette. I want a mix of pastel pinks, baby blues, and minty greens. And the furniture? Gone. Replaced with... (he gestures to a nearby servant)...plush, oversized bean bags.

SERVANT
(nervously)
Yes, your majesty?

KING
(smiling)
Yes, my good servant. I want the kingdom to feel like a giant, medieval video game.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The buildings are now a riot of color, with neon lights and pixelated graphics. The knights are wearing glow-in-the-dark armor, and the peasants are all sporting oversized, novelty sunglasses.

KING
(to Zorvath)
See? I told you it would work.

ZORVATH
(surprised)
It's... it's... (he searches for the right word)...fascinating.

KING
(smiling)
Fascinating? Ha! It's vaporwave, Zorvath. And it's going to change the world.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - LATER

The kingdom is bustling with activity. Merchants are hawking their wares, and peasants are all wearing the latest in vaporwave fashion. The king is sitting on his throne, surrounded by his advisors, who are all staring at him in awe.

KING
(to the advisors)
I told you, it's the future. And I'm the king of the future.

ZORVATH
(whispering to another advisor)
I think we're all going to be vaporwave-ized.

ADVISOR
(whispering back)
I think you're right, Zorvath.

FADE TO BLACK.
